pages.title: Gap Tool
pages.text: A four-mode teleportation tool. Switch modes from the item wheel, pick one of your named position slots, then right-click to act. Hold the wheel key while holding the umbrella to change mode, slot and travel distance.

$(bold)Record$() — right-click a block to save its position into the selected slot.$(br)$(bold)Waypoint$() — right-click to teleport yourself to the selected slot.$(br2)Manage slots from the umbrella screen: rename, delete and reorder your saved positions.

$(bold)Travel$() — hold use to charge, then dash forward through the border by the configured distance (default 1000 blocks, adjustable on the wheel).$(br2)Travel starts locked: combine the umbrella with a chorus fruit in an anvil to unlock it.

$(bold)Capture$() — interact with a living creature (not a player) to teleport it to the selected slot. Useful for relocating villagers, animals or captured youkai.$(br2)Capture starts locked: combine the umbrella with an echo shard in an anvil to unlock it.
